description: before.head set to a digest where before.seq is 0: head is null exactly when seq is 0, in both directions. A check that reads only a null head after seq 0 passes the statement rules, and the relying party's records, which fold from that head, then reject it as records instead. Accepting twin: sp3. Rests on rules.before_through (format) in statement/MANIFEST.json.
